scenarios.title: Prune under a custom format removes only branches that parse to milestone
scenarios.notes: Format feature/PROJ-1-{name}. Shipped branches: feature/PROJ-1-M-1 (goes), sdlc/M-2, feature/PROJ-1-M-3-e2e, feature/PROJ-1-S-001, feature/PROJ-1-run-1, main (stay). Also try names with a trailing slash, a prefix clash such as feature/PROJ-1-M-10, and a unicode lookalike. A wrong match deletes real work.

scenarios.title: branch_run returns a stored name only when it parses to kind run
scenarios.notes: Call branch_run(repo, branch, fmt) with runBranch feature/PROJ-1-run-1, sdlc/run-1, main, release/x, empty, a non-string and a missing key. Run under the custom and the default format. A stored name that is foreign gives the empty string. A malformed config or format gives Fail or the empty string, never a traceback.

scenarios.title: A foreign branch is not taken as the run branch
scenarios.notes: A leftover milestone branch with unshipped work whose committed config names main or sdlc/run-1 under the custom format. ensure_milestone_branch must not fail with 'belongs to run' and the prune must not delete it. Check the branch and its commits still exist after the call.

scenarios.title: A branch that names another real run branch still refuses
scenarios.notes: Control case for VS-3. The committed config names feature/PROJ-1-run-2 while the current run is run-1. ensure_milestone_branch fails with 'belongs to run'. The default format behaves the same with sdlc/run-2. The change must not weaken this refusal.

scenarios.title: A repo whose config holds feature/PROJ-1-{name} makes the janitor sweep under that format
scenarios.notes: Ledger marks S-001 done. feature/PROJ-1-S-001-v0-http-api-0 goes. sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0 and main stay. Try a branch of an unfinished slice and a branch that is not in the ledger: both stay.

scenarios.title: A repo with no branchFormat or an empty one makes the janitor sweep under sdlc/{name}
scenarios.notes: Same ledger as VS-5. sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0 goes. feature/PROJ-1-S-001-v0-http-api-0 stays. Repeat with branchFormat set to the empty string, with the key absent and with no config file.

scenarios.title: janitor.py takes its format from load_format and refuses a malformed format
scenarios.notes: Read janitor.py: it calls branches.load_format(repo) and holds no sdlc/ literal outside prose. Run the janitor with a malformed branchFormat (no {name}, unbalanced braces, git-unsafe characters, a non-string). It must delete no branch and must report the problem.

tools.purpose: Run state-write.py and janitor.py in scratch git repos and diff the refs.
Supply hostile branch names, formats and config values.
Call branch_run and load_format with generated inputs.

riskReason: Janitor deletes branches, so a wrong classification removes real work.
notes: Profiles are tagged in order of value: cli, security, contract. The slice has no stated number, so limits is not tagged. No http-api, async, concurrency, data, ui or i18n boundary exists. Round 1 follows a review fix. The fix removed added comments and moved the non-string runBranch cases into the committed branch_run test. Observable behavior did not change, so no scenario is added.
